bullet: Unknown model on a live session (`F09.acp-model-live-unknown`), known bug.
script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LID" --quiet --check supports_runtime_model_switch eq true \
  --check available_models contains '"model_id": "sonnet"' --check available_models not-contains qa-f09-nope
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$LID/switch_acp_model" --json '{"model": "qa-f09-nope"}' --expect 400,422 --save F09.acp-model-live-unknown/switch  # bug
